_comment: Copy for the App Store marketing screenshots, one entry per locale. The keys are App Store locale codes, which is what fastlane deliver accepts as directory names; ru is rendered on request only, since the listing has no Russian localization. Brand names (Action Replay, RetroAchievements) stay untranslated.

en-US.footnote: Game content is blurred for illustration.

ui.title: A clean, quiet interface
ui.body: Your whole library, ready to play. No clutter, no ceremony.

play.title: Nostalgia in high resolution
play.body: Internal upscaling makes 90s 3D look right on a modern display.

cloud.title: Save data that follows you
cloud.body: Back up, restore and manage every save in the cloud, on iPhone and iPad.

enh.title: Codes and achievements
enh.body: Action Replay codes and RetroAchievements support, built in.

ja.footnote: ゲーム画面はイメージのためぼかしています。

ui.title: 静かで無駄のない画面
ui.body: ライブラリをそのまま、すぐ遊べる形で。余計なものはありません。

play.title: 高解像度でよみがえる記憶
play.body: 内部解像度を引き上げ、90 年代の 3D を今の画面にふさわしい姿へ。

cloud.title: どこでも続きから
cloud.body: セーブのバックアップ・復元・管理をクラウドで。iPhone でも iPad でも。

enh.title: コードと実績
enh.body: Action Replay コードと RetroAchievements に標準対応。
